<#
  BlueStick — ONE CONTACT'S REMEDIATION LIST, in the penetration test
  report's format.

  This folder began as a copy of ../pentest and is yours to change in the same
  ways (Word styles, logo, title page image — Reports page → template files).
  template.json says "kind": "contact": it is filled when a project admin
  prepares a contact's document on the Remediation page, and is never offered
  for a client report.

  What differs from the report: the project information, executive summary
  and scope are replaced by a short front part — who the list is for, what is
  past or near its deadline, one line per finding — and every affected system
  carries the deadline of that finding on it (partials/_affected.qmd).  Each
  finding is printed exactly as the report prints it: description, impact,
  steps, evidence, recommendation.  A missing section prints nothing here
  (the report prints a TODO for its author; this reader is not the author).

  The data is a client report's, narrowed to the contact, plus:
    report.contact       name (may be empty) and email
    report.as_of         the day the deadlines were worked out
    remediation          overdue, due_soon, due_soon_days, open, closed,
                         not_listed, timeline (the deadlines in words)
    each finding         deadline — its most urgent one, in words
    each affected system deadline, due_on, deadline_state, assigned_on, team

  The original template's notes follow.

  Follows the original template's sections: Project Information (details,
  penetration testers, distribution list), Executive Summary (summary of
  findings, severity count with remediation timeline), System Description
  (networks, domains, applications, thick clients, other targets), Findings
  (one section each), Appendix (informational findings, disclaimer).

  BlueStick fills this Jinja template, then Quarto renders it.  Its delimiters
  never clash with Quarto (so this comment spells them out in words):
    statements   less-than percent  …  percent greater-than
    values       two less-thans     …  two greater-thans
    comments     less-than hash     …  hash greater-than
  A printed value is ESCAPED: text from the database always reads as text.
  Never print a value inside `code` or a code block (escapes are not undone
  there), and never in the YAML front matter — Quarto expands shortcodes in
  metadata even when escaped; use `bluestick-meta` (below) instead.
  Helpers (print them like a value):
    md(f, "description", todo="…")  a finding's written Markdown, filled in by
                                    _bluestick/fields.lua from data.json; when
                                    empty, the highlighted TODO instead
    md("executive_summary", todo="…")  the same for a top-level field
    todo("…")                       a highlighted "TODO: …" — every gap in
                                    the report is one, so a reviewer can
                                    search the document for TODO
    image(e)                        an evidence image (e from f.evidence — the
                                    images no written section places), as a
                                    numbered figure.  An image the author
                                    placed in a section prints inside that
                                    md() field, numbered in the same count
    code(c, "command")              a command line or tool output, verbatim
                                    (c from f.confirmations) — the only way
                                    to print either
    asset("logo")                   the path of one of this template's own
                                    images (template.json → assets) when its
                                    file is installed, else empty — wrap it in
                                    an if so the layout is unchanged without it
    plain(v)                        a date, number or reference, unescaped (checked)
  Reusable parts are INCLUDES (partials/), not macros: a macro's result is
  printed like a value and would be escaped.
  sample-data.json shows the data; `make html` renders it.
#>
---
# Never print database text in this YAML: Quarto expands shortcodes in
# metadata even when escaped.  bluestick-meta names the DATA instead, and
# _bluestick/fields.lua sets these keys from it as plain text.
title: "Security assessment report"
bluestick-meta:
  title: report.title
  subtitle: report.heading
# (The team is listed under Penetration testers.  `author` cannot be set this
# way: Quarto builds its title block from authors before this filter runs.)
date: << plain(report.date) >>
number-sections: true
engine: markdown
filters:
  - quarto
  - _bluestick/fields.lua
  - filters/spacers.lua
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-title: "Table of Contents"
    toc-location: body
    toc-depth: 2
    theme: cosmo
    fontsize: 11pt
    page-layout: article
    embed-resources: true
    # No formula is ever typeset, so no math library is ever loaded: the
    # report makes no request from the reader's browser.  (Written text is
    # read without math; this is the layer under that.)
    html-math-method: plain
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <style>
          table { width: 100%; }
          td, th { vertical-align: top; }
          img { border: 1px solid #555; padding: 2px; }
          pre, pre code { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
          img.bs-logo { border: none; padding: 0; max-width: 2in; height: auto; }
          mark.bs-todo { background: #ffe066; color: #1a1a1a; padding: 0 .25em; }
          div[data-custom-style="Table Caption"] { text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin: 1.25em 0 .35em; }
          div[data-custom-style="Table Caption"] p { margin: 0; }
          figure figcaption, .figure-caption { text-align: center !important; }
          </style>
<# The template's own images (template.json → assets) are the one thing
   printed here: asset() returns a path from the manifest, validated to plain
   path characters, or '' when the file is not installed — then the key is
   left out and the layout is unchanged. #>
<% if asset("logo") %>
    include-before-body:
      - text: |
          <p class="bs-logo-wrap"><img class="bs-logo" src="<< asset("logo") >>" alt="Logo"></p>
<% endif %>
  docx:
    reference-doc: reference.docx
    toc: true
    toc-title: "Table of Contents"
    toc-depth: 2
# No PDF format: the Word report carries the design and exports to PDF.
---

{{< pagebreak >}}

<# Numbered captions: every table caption counts up through the whole report
   (partials/_table_caption.qmd).  Figures are numbered by the filter
   (_bluestick/fields.lua), which sees the images placed in written text. #>
<% set counter = namespace(table=0) %>
<% set contact = report.get("contact") or {} %>
<% set summary = remediation if remediation is defined and remediation else {} %>
# Remediation list

<% with caption = "Prepared for" %><% include "partials/_table_caption.qmd" %><% endwith %>
<# An empty header row makes a table without one. #>
| | |
|:---------------|:--|
| Contact | << contact.get("name") or contact.get("email") or "" >><% if contact.get("name") and contact.get("email") %> (<< contact.email >>)<% endif %> |
| Project | << project.name >> |
| As of | << report.get("as_of") or report.date >> |
<% if summary %>
| Past the deadline | << summary.overdue >> |
| Due within << summary.due_soon_days >> days | << summary.due_soon >> |
| Open in all | << summary.open >><% if summary.closed %> (<< summary.closed >> already reported fixed, not listed)<% endif %> |
<% if summary.get("timeline") %>
| Deadlines | << summary.timeline >>, counted from the day a finding was assigned |
<% endif %>
<% endif %>

<% if findings %>
<% with caption = "Findings assigned to you" %><% include "partials/_table_caption.qmd" %><% endwith %>
| Ref | Finding | Severity | Systems | Most urgent |
|:------|:--------------------------------------|:-----------|:---------|:--------------------|
<% for f in findings %>
| << f.ref >> | [<< f.title >>](#finding-<< f.id >>) | << f.severity_label >> | << f.affected|length >> | << f.get("deadline") or "" >> |
<% endfor %>

<% if summary.get("not_listed") %>
<< summary.not_listed >> more assigned to you <% if summary.not_listed == 1 %>is<% else %>are<% endif %> still being investigated and <% if summary.not_listed == 1 %>is<% else %>are<% endif %> not in this document.

<% endif %>
{{< pagebreak >}}

# Findings

<% for f in findings %>
<% include "partials/_finding.qmd" %>
<% endfor %>
<% else %>
Nothing assigned to you is open in this project.

<% endif %>
## Disclaimer

This list reflects what was found during the assessment and what has been recorded about its remediation as of the date above. Systems change, and issues may exist that were not found.
